quests.title: Mutual Exchange

dialogue.t: Tomo tomo. Tomo dala si? Domu nye, ika nye.
Ye muhe dala? Mimi mani ye.
Ya tomo mani, mani yaya tome nye... Mi muhe du, du <color=#00E1FFFF>lata boya sada</color> si.
It appears to want something... Oh, I think there's something about this in my handbook, why not take a look?
Mi muhe du, du <color=#00E1FFFF>lata boya sada</color> si.
Mosi mita, yoyo tomo, mimi tomo.
Odomu tomo zido mi! <color=#00E1FFFF>Unta mosi dada</color>!
<color=#00E1FFFF>Unta mosi dada</color>... Feels like we've heard this before. Maybe it'll be in the handbook?
Domu movo si, Eleka nini si, tomo tomo. Tomo dala si?
Families change, tribes die out. And friends... Does friendship mean nothing!?
We just gave the wrong item, it's no big deal... No need to give up on the whole world.

quests.description: You go with Ella Musk to communicate with the hilichurls. Perhaps this might be the start of a new friendship…?
